work.title: Diptych with Targets
work.description: Gallery view of two framed collages displayed side by side against a grey wall. Left work features target rings, vinyl records, and yellow vertical stripes on crinkled paper; right work incorporates concentric-ring motifs, photographic fragments, and dense collaged borders surrounding a central white field.
work.composition: two framed works side by side
